messages.subject: Helio — negotiation issues note for client call
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

Ahead of Thursday's call with Brightwater, I've drafted the attached issues note on the Castle & Vane mark-up. Headline recommendation is to land the cap at 125% and offer a fixed £3m super-cap (down from our £5m) in place of their uncapped ask, hold the line on termination for convenience, and keep the anonymised-data right with tightened wording. Fallback package is in section 6.

Grateful for any steer before I send to the client.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100

messages.plaintextBody:
Good note. Agree with the 125% / £3m landing zone — that's well within Brightwater's PI cover. Push back firmly on uncapped data-protection liability; that is the one we cannot give. Happy for you to take the client through it.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
